===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:inh|enm:ani|:afeq|one|-y<id:adjectival>|tree=1}}
From {{inh|en|enm|any}}, {{m|enm|eny}}, {{m|enm|ony}}, {{m|enm|ani}}, {{m|enm|aniȝ}}, {{m|enm|eniȝ}}, {{m|enm|æniȝ}}, from {{inh|en|ang|ǣniġ|t=any}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*ainīg}}, {{m|gmw-pro|*ainag}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*ainagaz}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*ainaz||one}}, equivalent to {{af|en|one|-y|id2=adjectival}}. 

Cognate with {{cog|stq|eenich|t=some}}, {{cog|fy|iennich|t=only}}, {{cog|nl|enig|t=any, some}}, {{cog|af|enig|t=any}}, {{cog|nds-de|enig|t=some}}, {{cog|de|einig|t=some}}; via {{cog|ine-pro|*óynos}} cognate with {{cog|la|ūllus||any}}, {{cog|la|ūnicus}} (whence {{cog|it|unico|t=unique}}, {{cog|fr|unique|t=unique}}). {{piecewise doublet|en|unique}}.

#: {{co|en|make a '''deposit''' (put money in an account)}}

#: {{co|en|a mineral '''deposit'''}}
#: {{ux|en|a '''deposit''' of seaweed on the shore}}
#: {{ux|en|a '''deposit''' of jam on my countertop}}

#: {{syn|en|earnest money|down payment}}

# A place of deposit; a [[depository]].
